subject.title: fix: resolve Codex fork duplication when parent is unresolved (#2108)

question: Which branch should own the permanent Codex fork identity and cache-dependency contract across this PR and https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both branches modify the same persisted scanner identity/cache semantics with complementary behavior, and automation cannot safely choose the canonical contract or merge order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Consolidate one branch
options.body: Select one landing branch and combine canonical leaf-session identity, parent fingerprint invalidation, safe replay ownership, cross-window family invalidation, and the shared regression corpus.

options.title: Land this PR alone
options.body: Repair the two remaining defects and accept parent-scoped turn identity as the standalone contract after cold/warm corpus proof.

options.title: Prefer the overlapping PR
options.body: Close this branch only after the other PR incorporates and proves the unresolved-parent sibling replay behavior uniquely covered here.

recommendation.title: Consolidate one branch
recommendation.body: Select one landing branch and combine canonical leaf-session identity, parent fingerprint invalidation, safe replay ownership, cross-window family invalidation, and the shared regression corpus.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current provenance baseline and is best positioned to choose the repository's persistent scanner contract.
